name: CollegeRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to be #1 startup in your college
mechanic_twist: Each college gets own board; ₹100 min; leaderboard resets monthly; verified .edu email
why_gap_exists: 0 college boards in 411 list; 1000+ Indian colleges desperate for visibility
monetization: ₹100-500 per bid + sponsorship from college fests
india_angle: Perfect for IITs/BITS - Delhi University first

name: HarbergerRank.lol
one_liner: Own #1 but pay tax; anyone can buy you out
mechanic_twist: Harberger tax: you set self-assessed price; pay 5% daily tax; anyone can buy spot at that price
why_gap_exists: No Harberger board exists; solves whale squatting problem forever
india_angle: Novel economics play - buzz in crypto circles

name: LeaseRank - TimeSlot Bid
one_liner: Rent #1 for 60 mins during peak traffic
mechanic_twist: Slots sold like ad inventory; 24 slots/day; min $5/slot; countdown timer
why_gap_exists: All boards are forever-until-outbid; no time-leased board; founders want launch-hour spike
india_angle: IPL match / Product Hunt launch hour - Delhi timezone peak

name: PromptRank.lol
one_liner: Best AI prompts ranked by money
mechanic_twist: Prompts marketplace; pay to rank your prompt; buyers pay to unlock; rank = bid + sales
why_gap_exists: Only 1 prompt keyword in 411 boards; prompts are hot commodity

name: FoodRank Delhi
one_liner: Pay to be #1 dish in Delhi today
mechanic_twist: Hyperlocal: restaurants pay ₹200 to rank dish; bid becomes ₹10 coupons for first 20 orders
why_gap_exists: 0 restaurant boards; high buyer intent vs founder vanity clicks
india_angle: Start with Delhi NCR - Zomato killer twist

name: ShaadiRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to rank your matrimony profile
mechanic_twist: Profiles pay ₹500 to be #1 in city/age filter for 24h; verified Aadhaar; female profiles free
why_gap_exists: 0 matrimony boards; matrimony is ₹1000Cr market in India
india_angle: Controversial but Shaadi.com does similar with Boost

name: GigRank.lol
one_liner: Freelancers pay to rank for client brief
mechanic_twist: Clients post brief; freelancers pay $5 to rank proposal; client gets 50% of bids as discount
why_gap_exists: Only 2 hire boards; reverse marketplace untapped
india_angle: Indian freelancers on Upwork need edge

name: OpenSourceRank.lol
one_liner: Sponsor OSS to rank it
mechanic_twist: Bid money goes directly to GitHub sponsor of repo; rank = total sponsored; devs earn
why_gap_exists: No OSS boards; devs love supporting OSS; ethical twist

name: NewsletterBid.lol
one_liner: Pay to be sponsored in top newsletters
mechanic_twist: 5 newsletters bundle; pay to rank for next issue; verified open rates shown
why_gap_exists: Only 1 newsletter board; newsletter sponsorship is $300M market
india_angle: Partner with Indian creators - Figma, GrowthX

name: BillboardIRL.lol
one_liner: Pay online rank on real LED board in Gurgaon
mechanic_twist: Live camera of real billboard in CyberHub; pay online; your QR shows for 1 hour
why_gap_exists: 0 physical-digital boards; everyone does digital only
india_angle: Need 1 LED partner in Delhi - easy

name: AgentRank - x402
one_liner: AI agents pay machine-to-machine to rank
mechanic_twist: Uses x402 protocol; agents autonomously bid USDC to rank API endpoints; no humans
why_gap_exists: Only 2 x402 boards (nohumans.lol etc); agent economy exploding
monetization: $1 min + gas; infra for agent economy
india_angle: Build for Bangalore AI agent startups

name: ResumeRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to rank resume in recruiter feed
mechanic_twist: Recruiters see feed; candidates pay $10 to be top for 7 days; AI feedback included
why_gap_exists: 0 resume boards; Naukri charges ₹2000 for similar

name: EventHijack.lol
one_liner: Own #1 during IPL / WWDC / Demo Day
mechanic_twist: Board only live during event; 100 slots; $2 min; live visitor count spikes
why_gap_exists: No event-based boards; event attention is 100x normal

name: DomainBid.lol
one_liner: Expired domains ranked by bid
mechanic_twist: Expired .com/.in domains; pay to rank your domain for sale; escrow integrated
why_gap_exists: Only 3 domain boards; domain flipping is huge in India

name: PodcastRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to rank your podcast clip in feed
mechanic_twist: 30-sec clip plays on landing; pay to be #1 clip of day; listeners vote with listen time
why_gap_exists: Only 1 podcast board; podcast discovery is broken

name: NegativeBid - Pay to Bury
one_liner: Pay $2 to push competitor down 1 spot
mechanic_twist: Each $2 bury = -1 rank for target; target gets notified and can pay to recover; drama = virality
why_gap_exists: 0 bury boards; controversy drives clicks
monetization: $2 per bury; 50% goes to buried as credit

name: KarmaPool - Lose to Win
one_liner: Losing bids give karma to discount next bid
mechanic_twist: When outbid you get 50% as karma credit; karma decays in 7 days; forces rebid
why_gap_exists: No retention mechanic in any board; median $19 = churn problem

name: WhaleHunter - SquadBid
one_liner: 100 small founders pool to kill whale
mechanic_twist: Create squad; pool bids; if pool > #1 you share #1 as carousel; auto-split clicks
why_gap_exists: No pooling mechanic; whales scare small players

name: RentMyInbox.lol
one_liner: Recruiters pay to rank outreach to you
mechanic_twist: Candidates free; recruiters pay $5 to rank their DM to candidate; candidate gets $2 per read
why_gap_exists: No reverse recruiter board; candidate inbox is spam hell
monetization: $5 per DM; $2 to candidate = incentive to read

name: ReviewRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to rank but rank decays if bad reviews
mechanic_twist: Rank = bid * (avg rating); 1-star reviews tank you even if you paid $1000; verified buyers only
why_gap_exists: $1 + quality multiplier
monetization: Trust problem in pay-to-rank - this fixes

name: WaitlistJump.lol
one_liner: Pay to jump waitlist queue
mechanic_twist: Startups post waitlist; users pay $1-10 to jump queue; startup gets 70% of jump fee
why_gap_exists: No waitlist boards; waitlists are everywhere in 2026
india_angle: Use for exclusive Delhi clubs / events

name: CharityBid 2.0 - ESG Rank
one_liner: Corporate ESG leaderboard with tax receipt
mechanic_twist: Companies bid; 100% goes to NGO; get 80G tax receipt + ESG badge; ranked by total donated
why_gap_exists: Only 1 charity board (outcharity.com) but no tax angle

name: ShopifyRank.lol
one_liner: Pay to rank Shopify app in category
mechanic_twist: Shopify apps pay to rank for keyword "email marketing"; verified installs shown; anti-fake
why_gap_exists: Only 1 Shopify board (topshopifyapp.lol) but weak

name: MemeRank - Clip War
one_liner: Pay to push meme / reel to top
mechanic_twist: Reels compete; pay $1 to push; top reel auto-posted to IG page with 100k followers
why_gap_exists: Only few clip boards (clipwar.lol) but no distribution

name: MapMyBlock Delhi
one_liner: Claim Delhi blocks - Connaught Place etc
mechanic_twist: Warmap.lol clone but for Delhi: 100 blocks; own CP for ₹500; anyone can steal for 1.5x
why_gap_exists: Regional boards 18 but 0 city-block level
india_angle: Delhi pride - fight for your locality
